summary: All three cited divergences are resolved and none of the four edits introduced a new one or touched a Non-Goal. AC-5 is now met across every documentation home it enumerates, and its guard test is non-vacuous (verified: the old text would have failed it). The honesty guard listed only _VERIFY_LOCAL and _CLAUDE_MD, omitting docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md - so the test reported green while the claim in the very file AC-5 names survived verbatim. The gate and the defect were the same omission.

SECONDARY. Framed the producer as 'a command you run rather than a check in CI' and section 2.10 step 5 as 'remember to run this periodically', which stops being the whole story once it runs unattended on every shipwright-iterate SessionStart.
